label.en: Properties of iron and its compounds

cues.title: 铜出现时，铁去了哪里？
cues.titleEn: When copper appears, where does the iron go?
cues.caption: 铜出现时，铁去了哪里？
cues.captionEn: When copper appears, where does the iron go?
cues.zh: 铁丝上长出了铜，铁丝本身去了哪里？跟住表面这个铁：它给出两个电子，进入水中成为二价铁。一份铜离子接收这两个电子，留在金属表面。把这次观察记在图上：铁从零价变成正二价，反应伙伴是铜离子。
cues.en: Copper grows on the iron wire. Where does the iron go? Follow one surface atom: it supplies two electrons and enters the water as iron two. One copper ion receives those credits and joins the surface. Record the observed route: iron goes from zero to plus two, with copper ions as its reaction partner.

cues.title: 还是铁和铜，为何方向变了？
cues.titleEn: Still iron and copper—why a different direction?
cues.caption: 铜会长出来，还是溶解？
cues.zh: 现在换成铜片和三价铁溶液。先猜，铜会长出来，还是溶解？这一次，铜给出两个电子，两份三价铁各接收一个，成为二价铁；铜自己进入水中。图上新增正三价到正二价的路径。都是铁和铜，反应方向却要看具体是哪种粒子。
cues.en: Now use copper metal and iron three ions. Predict: will copper grow or dissolve? This time, copper supplies two electrons. Two iron three ions each receive one and become iron two, while copper enters solution. Add the route from plus three to plus two. The element names are unchanged, but the reacting species are different.

cues.title: 蓝色究竟在报告谁？
cues.titleEn: What does the blue actually report?
cues.caption: 蓝色在报告谁？
cues.zh: 把电子提供者换成碘离子。两份碘离子各给出一个电子，形成碘；两份三价铁成为二价铁。加入淀粉后，蓝色出现在含碘的显色体系里。跟住铁：它仍留在水中，没有变成蓝色小球。这条证据指向碘的生成，不能直接当作二价铁的检验。
cues.en: Replace the donor with iodide. Two iodide ions each lose one electron, producing iodine as two iron three ions become iron two. Starch then reveals the iodine-containing system in blue. Follow the iron: it stays in the water, rather than turning into blue particles. This evidence identifies iodine formation; it is not a specific test for iron two.

cues.title: 二价铁还能再接受电子吗？
cues.titleEn: Can iron two accept more electrons?
cues.caption: 二价铁还能得电子吗？
cues.zh: 二价铁是否只能作为终点？让锌与另一份二价铁溶液相遇，先作预测。锌给出两个电子，二价铁接收后成为金属铁。同一个铁从水里来到固体表面。新增的路径从正二价通向零价；面对锌，二价铁是电子的接受者。
cues.en: Must iron two be the endpoint? Predict what happens when zinc meets a fresh iron two solution. Zinc supplies two electrons, and iron two accepts them to become metal. The same iron moves from water to the solid surface. Add a route from plus two to zero: with zinc, iron two accepts electrons.

cues.title: 同一种二价铁，为什么又能交出电子？
cues.titleEn: How can the same iron two now donate electrons?
cues.caption: 二价铁也能给出电子吗？
cues.zh: 换成酸性高锰酸根，二价铁的角色反过来。五份二价铁各给出一个电子，一份高锰酸根接收这五份电子。它的四个氧没有消失，净账本把它们和八份氢离子记入四份水。紫色退去后，再用硫氰酸根检验生成的三价铁。并排看这两条路径：面对不同伙伴，二价铁既能接受，也能给出电子。
cues.en: With acidified permanganate, iron two changes roles. Five iron two ions each donate one electron; one permanganate receives all five. Its four oxygens remain accounted for: the net balance combines them with eight hydrogen ions in four waters. After purple disappears, thiocyanate reveals the iron three product. Compare the two routes: with different partners, iron two can accept or donate electrons.

cues.title: 显红也一定转移了电子吗？
cues.titleEn: Does red always mean electron transfer?
cues.caption: 显红色，就有电子转移吗？
cues.zh: 再看三价铁的显色对照。硫氰酸根参与配位，红色出现，中心铁仍是正三价。这次应该增加一条得失电子的箭头吗？不应该。把显色记录留在正三价这个位置：颜色改变，不一定意味着价态改变。这个对照将帮助我们判断最后一份样品。
cues.en: Now examine the iron three colour control. Thiocyanate binds, red appears, and the central iron remains formally plus three. Should we add an electron-transfer arrow? No. Keep this colour record at the plus-three position: a colour change need not change oxidation state. This control will help us interpret the final sample.

cues.title: 铁粉不足，红色会全部消失吗？
cues.titleEn: Will a small iron dose remove every red response?
cues.caption: 加铁后，还会显红吗？
cues.zh: 若一份金属铁面对五份三价铁，反应后还能显红吗？先别加检验试剂。金属铁提供的两个电子，只能还原其中两份三价铁；它自己也进入水中。数一数：三份二价铁，三份三价铁。再加检验试剂，红色仍可出现。判断铁的角色与反应结果，要一起看价态、反应伙伴和数量。
cues.en: Suppose one metal iron atom faces five iron three ions. Can the reacted sample still turn red? Keep the test reagent out for now. The metal supplies only two electrons, reducing two iron three ions; it also enters solution. Count three iron two ions and three iron three ions. The later test can still turn red. To predict the result, consider oxidation state, partner and quantity together.

question.zh: 二价铁为什么既能得电子，也能失电子？
question.en: Why can iron two both accept and donate electrons?

lead.zh: 把铜沉积、铜溶解、褪紫和显色，接成一张有证据的铁价态转化图。
lead.en: Connect deposits, dissolution and colour responses into an evidence-based map of iron oxidation states.

principle.zh: 氧化还原角色取决于具体价态与反应伙伴；在声明的净反应中，电子供需和物料守恒限制完成程度。配位显色本身不要求铁价态改变。
principle.en: Redox roles depend on the reacting species and partner. Within the stated net reaction, electron and material accounts constrain completion; coordination colour need not change iron oxidation state.

question.zh: 1份金属铁与5份Fe³⁺反应后，加入SCN⁻还可能显红吗？
question.en: After one metal Fe reacts with five Fe³⁺, can added SCN⁻ still give red?

explanation.zh: 可能。金属铁供给2个电子，消耗2份Fe³⁺，自身进入水中；留下3份Fe³⁺并形成3份Fe²⁺，剩余Fe³⁺仍可显色。
explanation.en: Yes. The metal supplies two electrons and also enters solution: three Fe³⁺ remain alongside three Fe²⁺, so a red response is still possible.

title.zh: 二价铁为什么既能得电子，也能失电子？
title.en: Why can iron two both accept and donate electrons?

description.zh: 让七个实验成为一张价态转化图：跟住同一个铁、电子和显色对象，再预测铁粉不足时会剩下什么。
description.en: Turn seven observations into an oxidation-state map, tracking iron, electron credits and the source of each colour before predicting a limited dose.

scientificBoundaries: All displayed unit recipes are illustrative integer net accounts, not the textbook doses, measured amounts or a laboratory procedure.
Formal oxidation-state nodes are not energy levels. The reaction graph records the declared textbook cases; conservation alone does not establish arbitrary reaction feasibility or kinetics.
Fresh chapters use distinct sample IDs. Atom phase transfers and electron-credit positions derive from the same frame. Credits are bookkeeping, not solvated electrons.

The Mn acceptor is an acidic net packet, MnO4− + 8H+ + 5e− → MnII + 4H2O, not a naked Mn7+ ion. Its oxygen/hydrogen route is one selected net allocation, not an elementary mechanism or isotope-provenance claim. Other pH branches are outside this model.
The SCN shot depicts one selected binding event at unchanged central FeIII; it does not solve the full population equilibrium. FeII coordination is omitted, not declared impossible.
The iodine response requires the declared iodine/iodide/starch context. The image is a qualitative host grouping, not a unique I3 structure, calibrated absorption spectrum or measured equilibrium.
The 1Fe + 5FeIII prediction gives 3FeII + 3FeIII, with all six Fe identities retained. It is a constructed stoichiometric transfer question, not a claim about the actual P90 reagent ratio.
No red diagnostic is assigned while MnO4 remains or before the reaction account is completed. Testing absent, pending and negative are separate states.
Copper in chloride solution may be complexed; no simple hydrated CuII colour or etching rate is inferred from the net electron equation.
Numerical guards bound finite inputs. Recipe variations do not modify the fixed textbook route records.
